title: Immune escape fitness decomposition: code and derived results
description: Code, tests, configurations and derived numerical outputs for model-conditional inference in tumor–immune CRISPR screens. Frozen results include 1,492 high-confidence records, 1,354 residual records, 10 stable residual modules and Tier A=0. Includes primary statistical runner and staged analysis sources; external ancillary evidence layers are not regenerated from raw data by one command. No third-party raw data or MSigDB memberships are redistributed. Original code: MIT; project-generated numerical tables: CC BY 4.0; upstream materials retain their own terms.
